title: Weekly Recap
description: Pull your week together from tasks, messages, and email into a structured Friday summary covering what shipped, decisions made, blockers, and next week priorities

children.text: Generate a structured end-of-week summary ready to share with a manager or use as a personal record. Ask the user to provide context from their task manager, Slack or team chat, and email threads. Work with whatever they provide.

sections.title: Step 1, Gather Completed and In-Progress Tasks

children.text:
Ask for, or work from, tasks completed or in progress this week (Monday through Friday):
- Task name and status (completed, in progress)
- Associated projects or work areas
- Any blockers or notes

sections.title: Step 2, Surface Key Decisions and Updates

children.text:
Scan any Slack exports, chat logs, or notes the user provides for:
- Decisions made (keywords: "decided", "approved", "confirmed", "green light")
- Things shipped or launched
- Blockers or risks ("blocked", "stuck", "waiting on", "delayed")
- Important context from managers or teammates

sections.title: Step 3, Check for Resolved Email Threads

children.text:
From any email context provided, look for:
- Threads that concluded or got a final reply this week
- Decisions or approvals from stakeholders
- Project milestones or blockers that were addressed
Compile everything into the template below. Be specific: name every project, person, and outcome. Nothing vague.

```
WEEKLY RECAP, WEEK OF [DATE RANGE]

SHIPPED THIS WEEK
- [Project name]: [What shipped, specific output]
- [Project name]: [What shipped]

IN PROGRESS
- [Project]: [Task name], [status or blocker]
- [Project]: [Task name], [status]

KEY DECISIONS MADE
- [Decision]: [Who decided, what was approved, outcome]
- [Decision]: [Details]

BLOCKERS
- [Blocker]: [What's blocked, why, who needs to unblock it]

NEXT WEEK PRIORITIES
1. [Project / task]: [What needs to happen, why it matters]
2. [Project / task]: [Details]
3. [Project / task]: [Details]
```

- Specificity is credibility. Name every project and outcome.
- One line per item. Add a brief detail line below only if needed.
- Focus on impact, not task completion for its own sake.
- If waiting on someone for a blocker, name them.
- Each next-week priority should have a clear owner and action.
